buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 2. Minimum Qualifying Criteria (MQC) a) The bidder shall be one of the JNP/PAP’s Labour Co-Op. Societies listed vide JNPA Circular No. /IR/JNP/PAP/2025 dated 07.08.2025. It should submit a xerox copy of Society registration certificate from the Authority competent to issue such registration certificate unde r the prescribed law in force. b) The tenderer should have at least 3 years’ experience in the conservancy of industrial establishmen ts or supply of manpower during last 7 years’ i.e. from 1st February 2019 till 31st January 2026. The tenderer should give a Xerox copy of the experience certificate issued by the employer clearing m entioning work nature, completed work duration and amount released to the party for the said peri od c) The tenderer should have completed successfully during last 7 years – i. Three completed works costing not less than Rs.56.22 lakhs each or ii. Two completed works costing not less than Rs.70.27 lakhs each or iii. One completed works costing not less than Rs.112.40 lakhs each.

In support of above condition, the tenderer should give xerox copies of the work orders along wit h work completion certificate for same work orders, issued by the employer mentioning that, t he work has been completed satisfactory. d) Average turnover of the Tenderer for the last three years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) sha ll not be less than Rs.42.16 lacs per annum. The Tenderer should give a xerox copy of Audited Acc ounts clearly indicating the profit and loss statement as well as balance sheet for each of th e 3 years duly audited by the certified chartered account along with valid UDIN number. e) The bidder should enclose TDS certificate in the form of 26AS indicating the name of the firm/com pany/organization whose experience shown by the bidder at point no. 2(b) & 2(c) above. The TDS c ertificate is mandatory in case of Govt. experience also. .
